list.name: Agent & Orchestration
list.description: The central CAD agent driving the build123d observe-edit loop (brief, coder triage/routing, codegen, run/inspect/render, gemma visual critique, edit), plus Onshape STEP upload and the CLI/Telegram command surface.

list.name: Learning & Retrieval
list.description: The learning loop that retrieves semantically-similar few-shot build123d examples via nomic-embed and stores/retrieves fail-to-fix lessons, with a SHA-keyed embedding cache and word-overlap fallback.

list.name: Domain Geometry Helpers
list.description: Deterministic build123d geometry factories (structural_section beams, involute spur_gear, hex_bolt) plus shared thread-pitch conventions, imported and trusted directly by the agent without visual critique.

list.name: Geometry Runners & Tooling
list.description: Standalone subprocess runners the agent shells out to per loop iteration: step (build123d source to STEP), inspect (geometry validation), and render (STEP to two-panel critic PNG).

list.name: Evaluation & Benchmarks
list.description: The text-to-CAD benchmark harness that runs each spec through cad_agent_v4 as a subprocess and scores the derived STEP geometry, driven by the 10-spec benchmark suite.

list.name: Reference & Capability Data
list.description: Read-only context for codegen: build123d capability notes (extrude-cut, fillet/chamfer, mirror, threads) and legacy Onshape FeatureScript example and learned snippets carried over from the v1 pipeline.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Top-level project documentation for CAD Agent v4.2: the PROJECT design doc, the operator-facing SKILL guide, and the BUILDS verification checklist.

file:b123d/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:b123d/__init__.py.summary: Package barrel for the b123d helper module, re-exporting the deterministic build123d domain helpers and shared conventions so the CAD agent loop can import them from a single namespace.

file:b123d/conventions.py.name: conventions.py
file:b123d/conventions.py.summary: Holds shared build123d conventions, notably a metric coarse-thread pitch table and a coarse_pitch() lookup used by the bolt helper.

file:b123d/domain.py.name: domain.py
file:b123d/domain.py.summary: Provides deterministic build123d geometry helpers (structural_section for I/H/C beams, spur_gear with true involute teeth, hex_bolt) that the CAD agent loop calls directly and trusts without visual critique.

function:b123d/conventions.py:coarse_pit.name: coarse_pitch
function:b123d/conventions.py:coarse_pit.summary: Returns the ISO metric coarse-thread pitch in mm for a given nominal bolt size, falling back to an approximation when the size is not in the lookup table.

function:b123d/domain.py:structural_sect.name: structural_section
function:b123d/domain.py:structural_sect.summary: Builds an extruded structural steel section (I/H/C beam) from web/flange dimensions using a build123d polyline cross-section, with optional mitre end cuts.

function:b123d/domain.py:_apply_mitre_b1.name: _apply_mitre_b123d
function:b123d/domain.py:_apply_mitre_b1.summary: Applies angled mitre cuts to the ends of a structural section by extruding and subtracting wedge solids at the part extremities.

function:b123d/domain.py:spur_gear.name: spur_gear
function:b123d/domain.py:spur_gear.summary: Generates a parametric involute spur gear from teeth count, module, width and bore, computing the true involute tooth profile via trigonometric strips before extruding the swept polyline.

function:b123d/domain.py:hex_bolt.name: hex_bolt
function:b123d/domain.py:hex_bolt.summary: Builds a hex-head bolt solid from nominal size and length, deriving thread pitch via coarse_pitch and extruding a regular-hexagon head atop a cylindrical shank.

file:cad_agent_v4.py.name: cad_agent_v4.py
file:cad_agent_v4.py.summary: The central CAD agent: drives the full build123d observe-edit loop (brief -> coder-triage -> codegen -> run/inspect/render -> gemma visual critic -> edit), handles coder model routing (7B<->30B), Onshape STEP upload, and the CLI/Telegram command surface.

file:cad_retrieval.py.name: cad_retrieval.py
file:cad_retrieval.py.summary: The learning-loop retrieval layer: nomic-embed semantic few-shot retrieval over the rated build123d corpus plus fail->fix lesson storage/retrieval, with a cached embedding store and word-overlap fallback.

file:scripts/run_benchmarks.py.name: run_benchmarks.py
file:scripts/run_benchmarks.py.summary: Benchmark harness that runs each text-to-cad spec through cad_agent_v4 as a subprocess, derives geometry from the produced STEP, and writes timestamped pass/fail results.

file:scripts/step.name: step
file:scripts/step.summary: Runner script that executes generated build123d source in an isolated namespace and exports the resulting solid to a STEP file; invoked as a subprocess by the agent's run_step.

file:scripts/inspect.name: inspect
file:scripts/inspect.summary: Geometry validation runner that loads a STEP file and reports bounding box, face/solid counts and validity, feeding the agent's inspect-and-revise step.

file:scripts/render.name: render
file:scripts/render.summary: Headless STEP-to-PNG renderer producing a two-panel (isometric + top-down) shaded image for the multimodal critic, drawn with matplotlib Agg and edge-less flat-shaded faces.

file:fs-examples/sweep.fs.name: sweep.fs
file:fs-examples/sweep.fs.summary: Legacy Onshape FeatureScript reference snippet demonstrating a sweep operation; standalone read-only example data.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:build.name: build
function:cad_agent_v4.py:build.summary: The core orchestrator: builds the brief, loads few-shots and lessons, routes the coder, then runs the generate -> step -> inspect -> render -> critique -> edit loop until DONE, finally uploading the STEP to Onshape and persisting session state.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:build_brief.name: build_brief
function:cad_agent_v4.py:build_brief.summary: Calls the brief model (qwen3:8b) to turn a free-text spec into a structured JSON build brief (dimensions, operations, optional helper hint).

function:cad_agent_v4.py:spec_needs_stro.name: spec_needs_strong_coder
function:cad_agent_v4.py:spec_needs_stro.summary: LLM triage that decides whether a spec is hard enough to start on the strong 30B coder instead of the fast 7B, parsing a JSON verdict from the brief model.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:generate_code.name: generate_code
function:cad_agent_v4.py:generate_code.summary: Generates build123d Python from the brief: either emits a deterministic domain-helper call (bolt/gear/section) or prompts the routed coder model, then strips fences and patches the code.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:revise_script.name: revise_script
function:cad_agent_v4.py:revise_script.summary: Asks the coder model to repair failing build123d code given the error/problem and current state, returning patched and fence-stripped source.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:decide_or_edit.name: decide_or_edit
function:cad_agent_v4.py:decide_or_edit.summary: Given warnings and the visual critique, asks the coder model to either reply DONE or return an edited script, driving loop termination.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:visual_critique.name: visual_critique
function:cad_agent_v4.py:visual_critique.summary: Renders the STEP to a PNG and sends it with the spec to the multimodal critic model (gemma4:e4b) to judge whether the geometry matches intent.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:run_step.name: run_step
function:cad_agent_v4.py:run_step.summary: Writes the generated source to disk and invokes the scripts/step runner as a subprocess to produce a STEP file, raising on failure.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:run_inspect.name: run_inspect
function:cad_agent_v4.py:run_inspect.summary: Invokes the scripts/inspect runner as a subprocess and parses its WARN/ERROR lines into geometry warnings.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:run_render.name: run_render
function:cad_agent_v4.py:run_render.summary: Invokes the scripts/render runner as a subprocess to turn a STEP file into the two-panel critic PNG.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:import_step_to_.name: import_step_to_onshape
function:cad_agent_v4.py:import_step_to_.summary: Uploads a STEP file to Onshape via multipart, translating it into a real editable Part Studio and polling the translation job, with private-default and auto-public fallback.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:_describe_docum.name: _describe_document
function:cad_agent_v4.py:_describe_docum.summary: Fetches Onshape document metadata, features and mass properties, then summarizes them via the brief model for the inspect command.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:_load_fewshots.name: _load_fewshots
function:cad_agent_v4.py:_load_fewshots.summary: Pulls semantically-similar few-shot examples via cad_retrieval, falling back to keyword-matched rated feedback rows from the feedback JSONL.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:store_feedback.name: store_feedback
function:cad_agent_v4.py:store_feedback.summary: Persists a user rating and the build result into the feedback JSONL, separating gold from rated rows for later few-shot retrieval.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:_ollama.name: _ollama
function:cad_agent_v4.py:_ollama.summary: Low-level Ollama generate client with retry, optional images (multimodal) and temperature; the single chokepoint all model calls go through.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:preflight.name: preflight
function:cad_agent_v4.py:preflight.summary: Pre-run check that Ollama is reachable and the configured brief/coder/critic models are pulled, raising a helpful error otherwise.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:_onshape.name: _onshape
function:cad_agent_v4.py:_onshape.summary: Authenticated JSON request helper against the Onshape REST API using basic-auth from configured credentials.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:distill_lesson.name: distill_lesson
function:cad_agent_v4.py:distill_lesson.summary: Uses the brief model to distill a one-line fail->fix lesson from a build problem and its final code, feeding the lesson store.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:_cmd_build.name: _cmd_build
function:cad_agent_v4.py:_cmd_build.summary: CLI entry for the build subcommand: parses args (coder mode, fewshots, chat id), runs build, and reports success/failure to stdout and Telegram.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:_cmd_inspect.name: _cmd_inspect
function:cad_agent_v4.py:_cmd_inspect.summary: CLI entry for the inspect subcommand: parses an Onshape URL and prints an LLM summary of the document's geometry.

function:cad_agent_v4.py:_cmd_refine.name: _cmd_refine
function:cad_agent_v4.py:_cmd_refine.summary: CLI entry for the refine subcommand (Satine convention): merges an original spec with feedback/history into a refined spec via the brief model.

function:cad_retrieval.py:retrieve.name: retrieve
function:cad_retrieval.py:retrieve.summary: Semantic few-shot retrieval: embeds the spec, scores corpus rows by cosine similarity (word-overlap prefilter), caches embeddings, and returns the top-n above a score threshold.

function:cad_retrieval.py:retrieve_lesso.name: retrieve_lessons
function:cad_retrieval.py:retrieve_lesso.summary: Retrieves the most relevant fail->fix lessons for a spec by cosine similarity over the lessons store, to inject as pitfalls-to-avoid into the prompt.

function:cad_retrieval.py:embed.name: embed
function:cad_retrieval.py:embed.summary: Returns the nomic-embed embedding for a text, served from a SHA-keyed cache and falling back gracefully when the embed model is unavailable.

function:cad_retrieval.py:load_corpus.name: load_corpus
function:cad_retrieval.py:load_corpus.summary: Loads the rated/gold build123d few-shot corpus from JSONL, skipping malformed rows.

function:cad_retrieval.py:store_lesson.name: store_lesson
function:cad_retrieval.py:store_lesson.summary: Appends a distilled fail->fix lesson to the lessons JSONL, deduping against existing lessons and capping the store size.

function:cad_retrieval.py:_word_overlap.name: _word_overlap
function:cad_retrieval.py:_word_overlap.summary: Lexical prefilter/fallback that scores corpus rows by token-set overlap with the spec when embeddings are unavailable or to narrow candidates.

function:scripts/run_benchmarks.py:run_o.name: run_one
function:scripts/run_benchmarks.py:run_o.summary: Runs a single benchmark spec through cad_agent_v4 as a subprocess, parses the JSON result, derives geometry from any produced STEP, and records pass/fail with timing.

function:scripts/run_benchmarks.py:main.name: main
function:scripts/run_benchmarks.py:main.summary: Benchmark CLI entry: parses tiers/filters, loads specs.json, runs each spec, aggregates pass counts, and writes timestamped plus latest result files.

function:scripts/run_benchmarks.py:deriv.name: derive_geometry
function:scripts/run_benchmarks.py:deriv.summary: Loads a produced STEP file with build123d and extracts bounding-box, face count and volume for benchmark scoring.

function:scripts/run_benchmarks.py:parse.name: parse_result
function:scripts/run_benchmarks.py:parse.summary: Extracts the agent's JSON result object from its subprocess stdout, tolerating surrounding log noise.
